_README: Nonlinear component modelling parameters + acceptance criteria used by the Pushover Analyst.
STATUS: the numbers below are PLACEHOLDER DEFAULTS written from memory of ASCE 41-17 Table 9-7.1
(beams) and the Lignos-based ASCE 41-17 column expressions. They are NOT verified against a licensed
copy of ASCE/SEI 41-23 or ANSI/AISC 342-22. The Pushover Analyst Grok Bot MUST send a retrieval plan
to Query file manager (doc AISC_342_22 / ASCE_41_23), copy the printed values into this file, set
verified=true and fill `source` with the exact table/equation ids and printed page. Until then every
report produced from this file carries a red UNVERIFIED banner. Never edit `verified` without doing the lookup.
source: placeholder -- ASCE 41-17 Table 9-7.1 (from memory); AISC 342-22 Ch. C / ASCE 41-23 Ch. 9 NOT retrieved

material.note: A992 W-shapes: Fye = Ry*Fy (AISC 341-22 Table A3.2 Ry=1.1 for ASTM A992). Confirm the ASCE 41/AISC 342 lower-bound and expected material factors.

beam_flexure.basis: compact W-shape beam, flexure, primary component; theta_y = Z*Fye*L/(6*E*I)
beam_flexure.note: Table values apply to compact flanges/webs (bf/2tf <= 52/sqrt(Fye), h/tw <= 418/sqrt(Fye)); otherwise linear interpolation to the slender limits in the standard -- prototype applies a flat 0.5 factor and flags it.

column_flexure.basis: wide-flange column, flexure with axial PG/Pye < 0.6 (Lignos-type expressions as adopted in ASCE 41-17 Table 9-7.1); rotations in RADIANS (plastic)
column_flexure.note: PG = gravity axial (QG) in the pushover; Pye = Ag*Fye. Columns with PG/Pye > 0.6 are force-controlled -> report P/PCL, no hinge.

brace_axial.basis: HSS brace, concentrically braced frame -- phenomenological axial backbone (ASCE 41-17 Table 9-8 form, PLACEHOLDER from memory); deformations are multiples of delta_c (axial shortening at expected buckling) and delta_T (axial elongation at expected yield)

compression.note: linear interpolation between the stocky and slender limits on KL/r

brace_axial.element: corotTruss + Hysteretic (no pinching, no cyclic damage) -- monotonic pushover; cyclic deterioration to be added for NLRHA
brace_axial.note: UNVERIFIED placeholders. Retrieve AISC 342-22 brace modelling parameters / acceptance and AISC 341-22 Table A3.2 Ry (A500 Gr. C) and F2.3 expected brace strengths (RyFyAg; 1.14 Fcre Ag) through Query file manager before use.

gravity_for_pushover.note: ASCE 41 Sec. 7.2.2 Eq. 7-1 form; QL = 25% of the unreduced design live load. Prototype distributes each level's weight equally to that level's column nodes. Verify clause and factors.

nsp.load_pattern: first mode shape x mass (ASCE 41 Sec. 7.4.3.2.3)
nsp.note: BSE-1N spectrum = ASCE 7 design spectrum (SDS, SD1); BSE-2N = 1.5x (MCE_R). Performance check: LS at BSE-1N, CP at BSE-2N (BPON). Confirm Table 7-4/7-5 and Eq. 7-28..7-32 numbering in ASCE 41-23.

numerics.note: post_cap_ratio = fraction of the capping rotation a over which strength descends from Mc to c*My (0.15 ~ ASCE 41 vertical drop). Raising it to capture the descending branch is a modelling change: only with the user's consent, and it is disclosed in the report. tail_strategies is the solver escalation ladder tried automatically when the push stops before 0.8*Vmax. Default plasticity=fibre (forceBeamColumn + Lobatto); member_nseg=4 matches MC4 fibre suite. Use imk for concentrated ModIMK / L2 FBC path.

fema_p695.note: Omega = Vmax/V ; mu_T = delta_u / delta_y,eff with delta_y,eff = C0*(Vmax/W)*(g/4pi^2)*max(T,T1)^2 (FEMA P-695 Sec. 6.3).

note: Opt-in flexible panel-zone modelling for ATC-114 / weak-PZ studies.
mode: 'rigid' (default, no behaviour change) | 'scissors' (zeroLength rotational spring at FR joint centerline).
scissors topology: column stack stays on the joint node; FR (unreleased) beam ends attach to a coincident beam-side node;
one 6-DOF zeroLength: rigid on translations/torsion/unused flexure + PZ spring on strong-axis rot DOF(s) 4/5.
Do NOT equalDOF beam-side to an RD slave (breaks Transformation). Beam-side nodes stay out of rigidDiaphragm slaves.
Optional K_theta override (kip-in/rad) or hysteretic.{s1p,e1p,s2p,e2p,s3p,e3p} absolute envelope.
IMK end hinges remain at member ends (centerline). Do NOT also apply AISC 342 C5.4a.1.a.1(b) PZ ductility
modifier when mode=scissors (double-counting). Not a full 8-bar Krawinkler rectangle (no geometric rigid offsets).
Pin-released gravity framing is excluded. Units: kip-in-sec.
